QuestInfo.name: Attendance Check
QuestInfo.0: So If I head over to #b#p9010000##k, then I'll be able to receive an attendance sheet? I see... so this is to check my ardent attendance to MapleStory. Sounds very intriguing...
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9010000##k told me if I take this attendance sheet to #b#p9200000##k, then I'll be able to receive PB & J Sandwich, Chocolate Milk, Chips, Cookie, and Fruit Roll Up in return. If I continue to gather the items for 14 days, then on the 15th day, I can get a special prize!  Apparently I have to come back every day to claim the prize!
QuestInfo.2: As I was successful in checking my attendance, I received scrumptious lunch items in return. I better keep these items that I received from #p9200000# somewhere safe. \n#p9200000# told me if I give him all the items on the 15th day, I'll get something nice as well!

0.0: Oh hello there! Are you enjoying the Back to School Event of MapleStory? How about joining me in participating the Attendance Event?
0.1: Starting September 11th, log onto MapleStory everyday. I'll give you an attendance sheet, and you can exchange it for 5 delicious lunch snacks through Cody. Cody will give you PB & J Sandwich, Chocolate Milk, Chips, Cookies and Fruit Roll Ups! If you attend Maple for 14 days straight and collect all these items, Cody will give you a special gift!

yes.0: Here's your attendance sheet. Take this to Cody to exchange it for delicious lunch snacks. He'll give you PB & J Sandwich, Chocolate Milk, Chips, Cookies and Fruit Roll Ups!

no.0: It really is a fun event, you know. You should really think about doing it. I even have great prizes for you... just so you know.

npc.0: Take this attendance sheet to Cody.

item.0: Great job keeping track of your attendance! Here's your PB & J Sandwich, Chocolate Milk, Chips, Cookies and Fruit Roll Ups! Make sure to come back tomorrow to receive the final prize.
